comment: While she could be a little rude towards some students sometimes, overall she was very kind and helpful. Her class was really enjoyable and I learned a lot about the subject and I enjoyed the classes.

I took her for Africana Studies Rumors of War. If I could rate her a 0 I would. If you want Africana studies for a major or minor, don't. It's not worth it. I ended up with a good grade, but it required an insane amount of work. I took the class because I was interested in the topic, and she entirely ruined the learning process.

Very few assignments, which made each one weighted heavily for the final grade. Unfortunately, the grading criteria were not clearly outlined. Points were often taken off without any explanation, making it difficult to understand how to improve or what was expected. During lectures, she came across as dismissive or condescending toward students.
she gatekeeps her slides from class like hello!!! you have to write down everything or you are screwed. she is very picky about grading and it is very unclear

does not care about poc even though the class is literally about african american women studies. she is insecure about people not taking her class seriously because it is also a gen ed and takes it out on everyone

I ended up with a good grade, but the amount of effort I put into the class was not worth it. She is VERY. unaccommodating and passive aggressive about it. Unless you do exactly as she asks, she will probably not like you very much. The actual content is interesting, but that doesn't make up for her being (imo) unkind towards her students.

Dr. McCommons can be super passive-aggressive. Make SURE to read the syllabus, somehow it comes up every class. The topics were interesting but the readings were long. Assignments are super heavily weighted as there are only a few so you have to do well on them. She's a good teacher but super hard to get on her good side....

Her class had in total 3 paper 1 final, 3 pop quizzes--to see if people are actually reading the assigned reading. Participation is 20% so you got to talk every class to get a good grade. She can get passive aggressive sometimes and is not understanding and can be unaccommodating when it comes to extending any deadlines regardless of your reason.
